Complete [[Thunderhead Keep]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Retake [[Thunderhead Keep (outpost)|Thunderhead Keep]]
* *BONUS* Light the beacons to draw additional [[Mursaat]] forces into Thunderhead Keep.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Thunderhead Keep#Walkthrough|Thunderhead Keep]] mission.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Mission]]
:''"[[King Jalis Ironhammer]] seeks assistance in retaking Thunderhead Keep from the [[Stone Summit]]."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The [[Zaishen]] admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*This [[quest]] was first offered on April 25, 2009.
*In order to receive credit for the first bonus objective, you must complete the mission.
